name: Brown-Forman
description: Brown-Forman is a family-controlled maker and marketer of premium spirits, led by Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey, with more than 40 spirit and ready-to-drink cocktail brands including Woodford Reserve, Old Forester, Herradura, el Jimador and Diplomatico. It distils and ages its own whiskey and tequila and sells to distributors, wholesalers and retailers (and through owned distribution companies in some countries); the whiskey must age for years, so inventory is built long before sale. It reports one segment. Sales fell 1 percent in FY2026 as US sales dropped 7 percent while emerging markets grew 14 percent.

sub.name: Drinks (soft drinks, energy drinks, beer and spirits)

employees.note: About 4,900 employees excluding part-time and temporary; 66 percent salaried, 34 percent hourly production.

businessLines.name: Premium spirits and ready-to-drink (single reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Sells cases of branded whiskey, tequila, rum, gin and RTD cocktails to distributors, wholesalers and retailers (and to consumers through owned distribution in some countries); price and mix per case drive revenue, and spirits require years of ageing so production is planned well ahead. Used barrels are also sold (non-branded and bulk).

brands.name: Jack Daniel's family
brands.note: Largest brand family, described as the most valuable asset; JDTW is the number one selling American whiskey (IWSR 2025). Brand-level revenue not disclosed in dollars.

brands.name: Old Forester
brands.note: Founding brand (1870); net sales +5 percent FY2026
